feature: Battle Royale CPU count and difficulty

real_peer_acceptance.scope: 3 OS processes over encrypted Holepunch isolated loopback DHT, 3 humans + 3 Hard CPUs; SIGKILL host, pause and migration retained 6 actors, settings, loot and healing. Not WAN/NAT acceptance.

full_regression.scope: All registered verifier scenarios; serial --full prefix plus 3-worker remainder; coop_launch isolated without pausing. Architecture/import and Python verifier checks passed in CLI prefix. Native UI and encrypted peers separate.

native_cpu_benchmark.scope: One native offline map, constant invulnerable population, 1440p viewport with production adaptive resolution. Includes movement, bot decisions, combat and pack capture. Run without other test workers. Not WAN/device acceptance or a locked FPS guarantee.
